title: Watergate complex, including the Watergate Hotel

orientationControl.basis: Five principal blocks: East, South, southern office, West, hotel and adjoining northern office portion. Detached former Howard Johnson hotel excluded. Curved outlines follow standard map polygons; floor and roof treatment follows the inspected 2025 aerial.

notes: Separate mapped curved bodies remain coordinated in one model. Residential blocks receive projecting balcony slabs, recessed glazing and fine white balustrade rhythm. Office wings retain flush strip glazing and wider concrete spandrels. The hotel wing has shallow balconies, lower entry canopy and rounded rooftop service forms. Exact roof equipment and planted terraces are interpreted from local photographs.
limitations: Map polygons and photographic heights are generalized, not surveyed. Fine balcony patterns and roof equipment are medium-fi interpretations.
Terrain is independently sampled coarse host data, not measured plaza or interior floor levels.
geometryLabel: Reviewed whole-complex building and podium outlines; generalized, not surveyed

terrainContact.basis: Central landscape court reference on independently preserved host terrain.

source: Generalized Protomaps building-part polygons, two inspected local Qualla exterior photographs, and the local labeled complex plan.
identityStatus: Coordinated site verified against the local labeled Watergate plan: West residence, northern office/hotel, East residence, South residence and southern office. Rounded T-shaped part is the hotel/office rooftop mass, not an extra tower. Former Howard Johnson hotel is excluded.

supplementalReferences.role: Inspected labeled plan identifies the hotel versus both office blocks and three residences; no copy embedded.
